label: human-3
people: None recorded in the header (the shim bug of the time). Chat player 1, an unnamed person (opponent or spectator; the record cannot say), gave the energy and constructor advice. The opponent played Armada (only Pawns seen). Ratings unknown.
our_side: Seat 0 (ai0, team 1), Cortex (random side), starting at E3 (4066,2237) on the north box. The player was claude-opus-5 at effort low on the claude2 account (Claude Code 2.1.278). The hands were Jev jev-latest (jev-1.13.0). No commander seat. Realtime, in the user's lobby; our seat's chat went out as player 2 (OConquor).
summary: The hands started the lab at 0:37 before any generator and before the player's first turn, and the energy store sat at zero from 0:46 to 1:54. The player's first packet asked for constructors first, the hands queued three in six seconds (1:06-1:12) and a fourth at 1:55, and the first Grunt was created only at 3:01. The opponent's Armada Pawns reached E4 at 2:02-2:08 against zero soldiers; the commander chased one party west (2:30-2:50) while another killed the windmills and extractors and, at 3:03, the lab, 931 from the commander. A second lab at spot_8 died at 3:34; the commander and two light turrets killed nine Pawns in 3:37-4:00, and the commander died at 4:00 with the energy store at zero. An unnamed person coached in chat throughout ('you are about to run out of e' at 0:56, wind on this map at 2:04, 'too many constructors' at 2:12), and the ledger records the user asking afterwards why it never built a unit.

root.what: The hands put the lab down before any generator, before the player's first turn, and the player's first packet then put constructors first. The store emptied at 0:46 and stayed empty to 1:54. The first unit, a constructor, took 43 s, and four constructors came before any soldier, so the Pawn rush of 2:02-2:08 met no army.

their_play: Armada, a Pawn rush. Pawns were first at E4/D4 at 2:02 and in our base by 2:20. They came in parties of 2-5 split between the west (spot_8) and the windmills and lab in the east, 7 at 3:14 and eleven in our base by 3:16 by our player's count. Their first kill was a windmill at 2:39; then five extractors 2:41-3:14, the lab at 3:03, the second lab at 3:34 and the commander at 4:00. He lost 11 Pawns (594 metal), nine of them in the last 25 s to our commander and two light turrets. His base, economy and tier were never seen: no truth file, and none of our units went to his side. This is the shape of K-open-early-pawn-pressure-is-standard (a handful of Pawns before anything else, at the opponent's base before 2:30).

bears_on.note: Three of its quoted lines come from this game: 'solar is better when you are out of e' (1:23), 'this map as 12 wind...' (2:04), 'too many constructors' (2:12). The game shows the cost: four constructors and no soldier when the Pawns came.
Energy before the factory is what makes a fast first constructor. With none, the first constructor took 43 s (1:10-1:53) at the stall.
The commander left the lab: it walked to spot_8 at 2:10 and chased Pawns at 2:30-2:50, and was 931 away when the lab died.
0:43: 'Cortex here, going eco-first with Grunts for defence.'
Seen from the receiving side: his first handful of Pawns crossed the map by 2:02 and decided the game by 3:03.

tools: direct reads of record-0.jsonl, jev-0.jsonl.zst, strategist-0.jsonl, bot.log
lens.caveats: No truth file, so his side is what we saw (floors). The header recorded no people. chat.jsonl marks every line '?'; I attributed them from the record's player ids: player 2 carries our banner and our player's lines, player 1 is an unnamed person. pro_baseline.py was not run (Quicksilver has no cards); K-open-matt-order-timings is the reference instead. The tools read the result as unknown (floor.py result '-', analyze_match 'outcome None after 0.0 min'); the commander's death at 4:00 is in the record and bot.log. The header's unit_defs ids do not match the engine ids in the events, so unit names come from bot.log and the hands' words. The date is 2026-09-21 local (wall_start 23:02 EDT, build committed 23:00): L-other-quicksilver says 2026-09-19/20 and the backlog says 2026-09-22. The ledger labels this batch human-3; the directory is named human-2.

open_questions: Who was player 1, the opponent or a spectator? The human-2 ledger row calls the same advice 'the opponent's', and the 3:18 line 'less e trouble this game, nice improvment' shows the speaker had seen the previous game.

Did the commander fire its D-gun at 3:37-4:00? The store fell from 685 to 6 between 3:40 and 3:55, but the record has no weapon events. If the store was empty when the last Pawns closed in at 3:55-4:00, it could not fire.
Would the commander standing at the lab at 2:40-3:03 have held it against five Pawns? It and two turrets killed nine in 25 s later on, which suggests so (reader's reading).
